description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for timesheet dates in the OrangeHRM system. It ensures that the provided date is not in the future and that the employee does not already have a timesheet for that date. The class uses traits for date-time utilities and timesheet service interactions.

classes.name: TimesheetDateRule
classes.description: Validation rule class that checks if a timesheet date is valid by ensuring it's not in the future and no existing timesheet exists for that date for the employee.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with the employee number.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input date to ensure it is not in the future and no existing timesheet exists for the date.
